==Gielinor Guide==
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' Greetings! I see you are a new arrival to the world of Gielinor. My job is to welcome all new visitors. So welcome!
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' You have already learned the first thing needed to succeed in this world: talking to other people!
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them you can talk to them.
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' Now then, let's start by looking at your settings menu.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#000080|Settings menu}}<br>Please [click/tap] on the flashing spanner icon found on the bottom right of your screen. This will display your settings menu.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to leave the building before finishing the beginning tutorial===
* {{tbox|You need to talk to the Gielinor Guide before you are allowed to proceed through this door.}}

===After opening settings menu===
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#000080|Settings menu}}<br>On the side panel, you can now see a variety of game settings. You can also [click/tap] the all settings button to see all available settings. Talk to the Gielinor Guide to continue.}}
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' Looks like you're making good progress! The menu you've just opened is one of many. You'll learn about the rest as you progress through the tutorial.
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' Anyway, I'd say it's time for you to go and meet your first instructor!
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Moving on}}<br>It's time to meet your first instructor. To continue, all you need to do is [click/tap] on the door. It's indicated by a flashing yellow arrow. Remember, you can [swipe across the screen/use your arrow keys] to rotate the camera.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Gielinor Guide again===

* '''Gielinor Guide:''' You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them, you can talk to them.
* '''Gielinor Guide:''' To continue the tutorial go through that door over there and speak to your first instructor!

===Speaking to the Survival Expert again===
* '''Survival Expert:''' Hello again. Is there something you'd like to hear more about?
* {{topt|Tell me about my skills again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about my skills again.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Every skill is listed in the skills menu. Here you can see what your current levels are and how much experience you have.
** '''Survival Expert:''' As you move your mouse over the various skills the small tooltip will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
** '''Survival Expert:''' You can also [click/tap] on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Woodcutting again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Woodcutting again.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and [click/tap] on a nearby tree to chop away.
** '''Survival Expert:''' As you explore the mainland you will discover many different kinds of trees that will require different Woodcutting levels to chop down.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Logs are not only useful for making fires. Many archers use the skill known as Fletching to craft their own bows and arrows from trees.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Firemaking again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Firemaking again.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Certainly, newcomer. When you have logs simply use your tinderbox on them. If successful, you will start a fire.
** '''Survival Expert:''' You can also set fire to logs you find lying on the floor already, and some other things can also be set alight...
** '''Survival Expert:''' A tinderbox is always a useful item to keep around!
** '''Survival Expert:''' Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Fishing again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Fishing again.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Ah, yes. Fishing! Fishing is undoubtedly one of the more popular hobbies here in Gielinor!
** '''Survival Expert:''' Whenever you see sparkling waters, you can be sure there's probably some good fishing to be had there!
** '''Survival Expert:''' Not only are fish absolutely delicious when cooked, they will also heal lost health.
** '''Survival Expert:''' I would recommend everybody has a go at Fishing at least once in their lives!
** '''Survival Expert:''' Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Cooking again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Cooking again.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Yes, the most basic of survival techniques. Most simple foods can be used on a fire to cook them. If you're feeling a bit fancier, you can also use a range to cook the food instead.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Eating cooked food will restore lost health. The harder something is to cook, the more it will heal you.
** '''Survival Expert:''' Is there anything else you'd like to hear more about?
** {{tact|other}}
* {{topt|Nothing thanks.}}
** '''Player:''' Nothing thanks.
** {{tact|end}}

==Quest Guide==
===Opening the Quest Guide's door===
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Quests}}<br>It's time to learn about quests! Just talk to the Quest Guide to get started.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Opening to go down the ladder before talking to the Quest Guide===
* '''Quest Guide:''' I don't think you're ready to go down there yet.
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Quest Guide===
* '''Quest Guide:''' Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest list.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Quest journal}}<br>[Click]/[tap] on the flashing icon to the left of your inventory.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Quest Guide before opening your quest journal===
* '''Quest Guide:''' Have you not opened that menu yet?
* {{tact|end}}

===Opening the quest journal===
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Quest journal}}<br>This is your quest journal. It lists every quest in the game. Talk to the quest guide again for an explanation on how it works.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Quest Guide after viewing the quest journal===
* '''Quest Guide:''' Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.
* '''Quest Guide:''' If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
* '''Quest Guide:''' It's very easy to find quest start points. Just look out for the quest icon on your minimap. You should see one marking this house.
* {{tbox|pic=Quests.png|The minimap in the top right corner of the screen has various icons to show different points of interest. Look for the icon to the left to find quest start points.}}
* '''Quest Guide:''' The quests themselves can vary greatly from collecting beads to hunting down dragons. Completing quests will reward you with all sorts of things, such as new areas and better weapons!
* '''Quest Guide:''' There's not a lot more I can tell you about questing. You have to experience the thrill of it yourself to fully understand. Let me know if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Moving on}}<br>It's time to enter some caves. [Click/Tap] on the ladder to go down to the next area.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Quest Guide again===

* {{tselect|Select an Option}}

** '''Quest Guide:''' Within your quest list, you'll unsurprisingly find a list of quests. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.
** '''Quest Guide:''' If you haven't started the quest, it will tell you where to begin and what requirements you need. If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
** {{tact|above}}

** '''Quest Guide:''' Okay then.
** {{tact|end}}

===After entering the caves===

* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Mining Instructor===
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Hi there. You must be new around here. So what do I call you? 'Newcomer' seems so impersonal, and if we're going to be working together, I'd rather call you by name.
* '''Player:''' You can call me [player name].
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some?
* {{tact|receives=a bronze pickaxe}}
* {{tbox|pic=Bronze pickaxe detail.png|The mining instructor gives you a {{Colour|#000080|bronze pickaxe}}.}} 
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Mining}}<br>It's quite simple really. To mine a rock, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it. First up, try mining some tin.}}

===Mining a rock===
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Please Wait}}<br>Your character is now attempting to mine the rock. This should only take a few seconds.}}
* {{tbox|You manage to mine some [tin/copper].}}
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Mining}}<br>Now that you have some [tin/copper] ore, you just need some [copper/tin] To mine a rock, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it.}}

===Before obtaining both ores===
* '''Mining Instructor:''' The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some.
* {{tact|end}}

===Attempting to mine ore with a full inventory===
* {{tbox|You don't have enough room in your inventory to hold the ore. You'll need to drop something. To do so, [tap and hold/right-click on] an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, try mining the rock again.}}

===After obtaining both ores===
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Now that you have some ore, you should smelt it into a bronze bar. You can use the furnace over there to do so.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Smelting}}<br>You now have some tin ore and some copper ore. You can smelt these into a bronze bar. To do so, just [click/tap] on the indicated furnace. Try it now.}}

===Smelting bronze===
* {{tbox|You smelt the copper and tin together in the furnace.}}
* {{tbox|You retrieve a bar of bronze.}}
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Smithing}}<br>You've made a bronze bar! Speak to the mining instructor and he'll show you how to make it into a weapon.}}

===Attempting to use an anvil before receiving a hammer===
* {{tbox|You need a hammer to work the metal with. Talk to the mining instructor to get one.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Mining Instructor after smelting a bronze bar===
* '''Player:''' I have a bronze bar. What now?
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Now that you've got a bar, you can smith it into a weapon. To smith something, you need a hammer and an anvil. There's some anvils just here that you can use. See if you can make a bronze dagger.

===Talking to the Mining Instructor again===
* {{tact|The player receives a hammer if they have space and are not currently carrying one:}}
* '''Mining Instructor:''' Would you like me to recap anything?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Mining again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about mining again.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Certainly. To mine you need a pickaxe. Different pickaxes let you mine more efficiently.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe. It's the most inefficient pickaxe available, but it's perfect for a beginner.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' To mine, simply [click/tap] on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' The better the pickaxe you use, the faster you will get ore from the rock you're mining.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' You will be able to buy better pickaxes from the Dwarven Mine when you reach the mainland, but they can be expensive.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Also, the better the pickaxe the higher the Mining level required to use it will be. Was there anything else you wanted to hear?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about smelting again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about smelting again.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Smelting is very easy. Simply take the ores required to make a metal to a furnace, then use the ores on the furnace to smelt them into a bar of metal.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Furnaces are expensive to build and maintain, so there are not that many scattered around the world. I suggest when you find one you remember its location for future use.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' An alternative to using a furnace to smelt your ore is to use high-level magic to do it.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' As well as letting you smelt ore anywhere, it has a guaranteed success rate in smelting all ores.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Some metals, such as iron, contain impurities and can be destroyed during the smelting process in a traditional furnace, but magical heat does not destroy them.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Anything else?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Smithing again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Smithing again.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' When you have acquired enough bars of the metal you wish to work with, you are ready to begin smithing.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Take the hammer I gave you, or buy a new one from a general store, and proceed to a nearby anvil.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' By using a metal bar on an anvil you will be presented with a screen showing the objects you are able to smith at your current level.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' It's a pretty straightforward skill as I'm sure you discovered while making me that lovely bronze dagger.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' The higher Smithing level you are, the better quality the metal you can work with. You start off on bronze and work your way up as your smithing skills increase.
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Anything else?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Nope, I'm ready to move on!}}
** '''Player:''' Nope, I'm ready to move on!
** '''Mining Instructor:''' Okay then.
** {{tact|end}}

* '''Combat Instructor:''' Next up we have ranged combat. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.

===Talking to the Combat Instructor again===
* '''Combat Instructor:''' Do you need something?
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Tell me about combat stats.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about combat stats again.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Certainly. You have three main combat stats: Strength, Defence and Attack.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Strength determines the maximum hit you will be able to deal with your blows, Defence determines the amount of damage you will be able to defend and Attack determines the accuracy of your blows.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Other stats are used in combat such as Prayer, Hitpoints, Magic and Ranged. All of these stats can go towards determining your combat level, which is shown near the top of your combat interface screen.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' You will find out on the mainland that certain items can also affect your stats. There are potions that can be drunk that can alter your stats temporarily, such as raising Strength.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' You will also raise your Defence and Attack values by using different weapons and armours.
** {{tcond|If playing on desktop:}}
*** '''Combat Instructor:''' Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to put the mouse over them and see what combat level they are.
*** {{tact|continue}}
** {{tcond|If playing on mobile:}}
*** '''Combat Instructor:''' Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to see what combat level they are.
*** {{tact|continue}}
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Green coloured writing usually means it will be an easy fight for you, red means you will probably lose, yellow means they are around your level and orange means they are slightly stronger.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Sometimes things will go your way, sometimes they won't. There is no such thing as a guaranteed win, but if the odds are on your side, you stand the best chance of walking away victorious.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Now, was there something else you wanted to hear about again?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about melee combat again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about melee combat again.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Ah, my speciality. Close combat fighting, which is also known as melee fighting, covers all combat done at close range to your opponent.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Melee fighting depends entirely upon your three basic combat stats: Attack, Defence, and Strength.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Also, of course, it depends on the quality of your armour and weaponry. A high-levelled fighter with good armour and weapons will be deadly up close.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' If this is the path you wish to take, remember your success depends on getting as close to your enemy as quickly as possible.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Personally, I consider the fine art of melee combat to be the ONLY combat method worth using.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Now, did you want to hear anything else?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about ranged combat again.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about ranged combat again.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Thinking of being a ranger, eh? Well, okay. I don't enjoy it myself, but I can see the appeal.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Ranging employs a lot of different weapons as a skill, not just the shortbow you have there. Spears, throwing knives, and crossbows are all used best at a distance from your enemy.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Now, those rats were easy pickings, but on the mainland you will be very lucky if you can find a spot where you can shoot at your enemies without them being able to retaliate.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' At close range, rangers often do badly in combat. Your best tactic as a ranger is to hit and run, keeping your foe at a distance.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Your effectiveness as a ranger is almost entirely dependent on your Ranged stat. As with all skills, the more you train it, the more powerful it will become.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Anything else you wanted to know?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Tell me about the Wilderness.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about the Wilderness again.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Ah yes, the Wilderness. It is a place of evil, mark my words. Many is the colleague I have lost in that foul place.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' It is also a place of both adventure and wealth, so if you are brave enough and strong enough to survive it, you will make a killing. Literally!
** '''Combat Instructor:''' It is also the only place in the land of Gielinor where players are able to attack each other at will, and as such is the haunt of many Player Killers, or PKers if you will.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' There are a few things different in the Wilderness in comparison to the rest of the lands of Gielinor. Firstly, as I just mentioned, you can and will be attacked by other players.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' For this reason, you will be given a warning when you approach the Wilderness, as it is not a place you would wish to enter by accident.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Secondly, there are a number of 'levels' to it. The further into it you travel, the greater the range of people you can attack.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' In level 1 wilderness you will only be able to attack, or be attacked by, those players within one combat level of yourself.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' In level 50, any player within fifty levels of you will be able to attack, or be attacked by you. Always keep an eye on what level of the Wilderness you are currently in.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Your current Wilderness level is shown at the bottom right of the screen. The final thing you should know about the Wilderness is being 'skulled'.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' If you attack another player without them having attacked first, you will gain a skull above your character's head.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' What this means is that if you die while skulled, you will lose EVERYTHING that your character was carrying.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' When skulled, you should try to avoid dying for the twenty minutes or so it will take for the skull to wear off.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' If you wish to find the Wilderness, head north from where you start on the mainland. It is rather large and hard to miss.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' If you don't wish to end up there, take notice of the warning you will receive when getting near to it.
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Now, was there anything more?
** {{tact|initial}}
* {{topt|Nope, I'm ready to move on!}}
** '''Player:''' Nope, I'm ready to move on!
** '''Combat Instructor:''' Okay then.
** {{tact|end}}

===Accessing the poll booth===
* {{tbox|Poll booths are found in towns across the world. The Old School RuneScape community is invited to vote on future game updates, to decide whether each update should or shouldn't be released.}}
* {{tbox|Voting is open to {{Colour|#7f0000|members}} with a {{Colour|#7f0000|skill total of 300}}. To preserve the old-school character of this game, an update must gain {{Colour|#7f0000|70%}} support to be released.}}
* {{tbox|pic=5085 detail.png|A flag appears on the booth to let you know when you're invited to vote in a poll.}}

===Talking to the Account Guide===
* '''Player:''' Hello. Who are you?
* '''Account Guide:''' I'm the Account Guide. I'm here to tell you about your account.
* '''Player:''' What's an account?
* '''Account Guide:''' Your character IS your account! It's what you are using to play the game right now. Everyone here has one and some people even have multiple!
* '''Account Guide:''' There's various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let's take a look at it now.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Account Management}}<br>[Click/tap] on the flashing icon to open your Account Management menu.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Account Guide before opening the Account Management menu===
* '''Account Guide:''' Before we go any further, you should have a look at the Account Management menu.
* {{tact|end}}

===Opening the Account Management menu===
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Account Management}}<br>This is your Account Management menu where you can control various aspects of your account. Talk to the Account Guide to learn more.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Account Guide after opening the Account Management menu===
* '''Account Guide:''' As you can see, there's a few things you can do with your account.
* {{tact|opens=Account Management}}
* '''Account Guide:''' First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
* '''Player:''' What's a world?
* {{tact|opens=Logout}}
* '''Account Guide:''' A world is what you play the game on. Most worlds can hold up to 2000 players. They are split into two main types: free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the World Switcher in the Logout menu.
* {{tcond|If the player is on a free world:}}
** '''Account Guide:''' You are currently on a free world. If you want to switch to a members' world and enjoy all of the benefits, you'll need to purchase membership. You can do so using the store in the Account Management menu.
* {{tcond|If the player is on a members world:}}
** '''Account Guide:''' You are currently on a members' world so you already have access to everything that being a member has to offer. Enjoy!
* {{tact|opens=Account Management}}
* '''Account Guide:''' Bonds are another thing that you should know about. You can purchase Bonds from the store in the Account Management menu. Once you have some Bonds, you can redeem them for membership!
* '''Player:''' But why would I use a Bond instead of just buying membership normally?
* '''Account Guide:''' Unlike membership, Bonds can be traded with other players. You could purchase a Bond and then sell it to another player for some gold. Alternatively, you could use your gold to buy a Bond from another player!
* '''Player:''' So if I used my gold to buy a Bond from another player, I could get membership without spending any real money?
* '''Account Guide:''' Exactly!
* '''Account Guide:''' Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
* '''Account Guide:''' The name changer allows you to change your display name if you don't like your current one. Be aware though that this is only available to accounts with membership.
* '''Player:''' Awesome. Is there anything else I should know about accounts?
* '''Account Guide:''' Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. Various tools can help with this, such as Bank PINs and two-factor authentication options.
* {{tact|opens=Account Management#Links}}
* '''Account Guide:''' You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the Useful Links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
* '''Account Guide:''' Anyway, that's everything I have to tell you about accounts. Let me know if you need a recap, otherwise head on to your next instructor.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Moving on}}<br>Continue through the next door.}}
* {{tact|end}}

===Talking to the Account Guide again===
* '''Account Guide:''' Hello. Would you like to hear about your account again?
* {{tselect|Would you like to hear about your account again?}}
* {{topt|Yes!}}
** '''Player:''' Yes!
** '''Account Guide:''' Excellent. Well there's a few things you can do with your account.
** '''Account Guide:''' First, you have membership. All accounts are free to play by default but if you desire, you can buy membership to unlock members' worlds. These worlds give you access to extra skills, areas, quests, and more!
** {{tact|above}}
* {{topt|No thanks.}}
** {{tact|end}}

===Talking to Brother Brace===
* '''Player:''' Good day, brother.
* '''Brother Brace:''' Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer.

===Talking to Brother Brace before opening a highlighted menu===

===Opening the prayer menu===

===Talking to Brother Brace after opening the prayer menu===
* '''Brother Brace:''' This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click]/[Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click]/[tap] it again to deactivate it.
* '''Brother Brace:''' Active prayers will drain your Prayer Points, which you can recharge by finding an altar or other holy spot and praying there.
* '''Brother Brace:''' As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by [clicking]/[tapping] them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
* '''Brother Brace:''' That's all I have to teach you for now. If you need a reminder about your prayers, just speak to me again.
* {{tbox|{{Colour|#0000ff|Your final instructor!}}<br>You're almost finished on tutorial island. Pass through the door to find the path leading to your final instructor.}}
* {{tact|end}}

==Ironman tutor==
===Speaking to the Ironman tutor===
* {{tcond|If the player is on a regular account:}}
** '''Ironman tutor:''' Hello, [player name]. I'm Paul, the Ironman tutor. What can I do for you?
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{tcond|If the player is an Ironman:}}
** '''Player:''' Hey there Paul.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' Hail, [Ironman type]! What can I do for you?
** {{tact|continue}}
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
* {{topt|Tell me about Ironman.}}
** '''Player:''' Tell me about Ironmen.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' When you play as an {{Colour|#7f0000|Ironman}}, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' As an {{Colour|#7f0000|Ironman}}, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become a {{Colour|#b10000|Hardcore Ironman}}.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' In addition to the standard restrictions, {{Colour|#b10000|Hardcore Ironmen}} only have {{Colour|#b10000|one life}}. In the event of a dangerous death, your {{Colour|#b10000|Hardcore Ironmen}} status will be downgraded to that of a {{Colour|#7f0000|standard Ironman}}, and your
** '''Ironman tutor:''' stats will be frozen on the {{Colour|#b10000|Hardcore Iron man}} hiscores.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, as {{colour|#7f0000|Group Ironmen}}. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Ironmen except you can trade your items with each other!
** '''Ironman tutor:''' If you are a daring bunch, you could even try {{colour|#b10000|Hardcore Group Ironmen}}. With Hardcore Group Ironmen you have a set number of lives, when they reach zero, you will become regular {{colour|#7f0000|Group Ironmen}}.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' If you ever decided to invite experienced players to your group, you would become {{colour|#7f0000|Unranked Group Ironmen}}, which are no longer shown on the Group Ironman hiscores.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become an {{colour|#00007f|Ultimate Ironman}}, a game mode inspired by the player {{colour|#00007f|IronNoBank}}.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' In addition to the standard restrictions, {{colour|#00007f|Ultimate Ironmen}} are blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being a {{colour|#7f0000|standard Ironman}}, an {{colour|#00007f|Ultimate Ironman}}, a {{colour|#b10000|Hardcore Ironman}}, a {{colour|#7f0000|Group Ironman}}, a {{colour|#b10000|Hardcore Group Ironman}} or a regular character.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' Once you've left this island, you'll be able to find my colleague Adam in Lumbridge, but he'll only let you switch your restrictions downwards, not upwards.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' So he will let {{Colour|#b10000|Hardcore Ironmen}} or {{Colour|#00007f|Ultimate Ironmen}} downgrade to {{Colour|#7f0000|standard Ironmen}}, and he'll let all types of {{Colour|#00007f|Ironman}} become normal players.
** '''Ironman tutor:''' I must warn you that Ironman mode is not recommended for new players. You can still give it a go if you think you're up for the challenge though.
** {{tselect|Select an option}}
** {{topt|I'd like to change my Ironman mode.}}
*** '''Player:''' I'd like to change my Ironman mode.
*** {{tact|opens=Ironman}}
*** '''Ironman tutor:''' Make sure you've got your Ironman settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.
*** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|I'm fine, thanks.}}
*** {{tact|below}}
* {{topt|I'm fine, thanks.}}
** '''Player:''' I'm fine, thanks.
** {{tact|end}}

=== [[Fresh Start Worlds]] dialogue ===
<!--Fresh Start Worlds ran from 19 October 2022 to 18 April 2023, during which time the NPC's name was "Iron Man tutor."-->
* '''Player:''' I'd like to change my Iron Man mode.
* '''Iron Man tutor:''' If you're interested in the Fresh Start Worlds, you should know that you can't be an Iron Man on those.
* {{tselect|Select an Option}}
** {{topt|What are Fresh Start Worlds?}}
*** '''Player:''' What are Fresh Start Worlds?
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' Fresh Start Worlds are worlds that have a fresh economy to build and fresh hiscores to chase.
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' They're a way to experience Old School RuneScape as if it were new, today!
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' They will last for 6 months, after which your account will be transfered{{sic}} to the main game and you can carry on playing as normal there.
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' There is a World First system, which are achievements only obtainable once on all worlds, so you can race against others for these!
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' If a global race is a bit too much, then there is also an Achievement Point system. You can compete against your friends to get the most points.
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' Other than that, it's the same Old School experience you know and love, with all the same content as the main game.
*** '''Iron Man tutor:''' Do you still wish to proceed with selecting an Iron Man mode?
*** {{tselect|Select an Option}}
*** {{topt|Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.}}
**** '''Player:''' Yes, I'm not interested in Fresh Start Worlds.
**** '''Iron Man tutor:''' That's okay. If you change your mind you can find out more about Fresh Start Worlds by speaking to the Magic Instructor, assuming you're not an ironman.
**** '''Iron Man tutor:''' You'll have to remove any ironman status first by speaking to me.
**** {{tact|end}}
*** {{topt|No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!}}
**** '''Player:''' No, Fresh Start Worlds sound like my sort of thing!
**** '''Iron Man tutor:''' Lovely! You can talk to the Magic Instructor to find out more about Fresh Start Worlds.
**** {{tact|end}}
** {{topt|That's fine, I'm not interested in those.}}
